-- Step 1: Archive all 8 templates to history before modifying
INSERT INTO sequenceTemplateHistory (templateId, prevSubject, prevBodyHtml, prevBodyText, prevDelayHours, prevIsActive, editedBy, changeNote)
SELECT id, subject, bodyHtml, bodyText, delayHours, isActive, 'system_emergency_fix', 'Pre-fix archive: /camp URL → /camp-registration (2026-06-09 emergency)'
FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture';

-- Step 2: Fix all occurrences of tmatkd.com/camp in bodyText (not /camp-registration already)
UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET 
  bodyText = REPLACE(bodyText, 'tmatkd.com/camp-registration', '%%PLACEHOLDER_CORRECT%%'),
  bodyHtml = REPLACE(bodyHtml, 'tmatkd.com/camp-registration', '%%PLACEHOLDER_CORRECT%%')
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture';

UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET 
  bodyText = REPLACE(bodyText, 'tmatkd.com/camp', 'tmatkd.com/camp-registration'),
  bodyHtml = REPLACE(bodyHtml, 'tmatkd.com/camp', 'tmatkd.com/camp-registration')
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture';

UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET 
  bodyText = REPLACE(bodyText, '%%PLACEHOLDER_CORRECT%%', 'tmatkd.com/camp-registration'),
  bodyHtml = REPLACE(bodyHtml, '%%PLACEHOLDER_CORRECT%%', 'tmatkd.com/camp-registration')
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture';
